Constraints
* Please change 100 to 10 as [[S]] never contains more than 10 digits.

Cases
* Please add a pair of cases where [[S]] starts with 0, and the expected outputs differ from those of all other cases. The test and the validator should also expect different outputs.

* Please add a pair of cases where [[S]] consists of odd digits only and the expected output is 0.

* Please add a pair of cases where [[S]] consists of even digits only and the expected output is 0.

* Please add a pair of cases where [[S]] consists of two digits only and the expected output is 1.

Thanks.

Your mission to "100% codingame" is very impressive, however I don't think creating easy leetcode problems en mass as community problems is very helpful. These basic tasks are almost certainly duplicates, in the case of this specific problem "https://www.codingame.com/contribute/view/1228d62225c1f6ea86732eb4defb637c49" seems like one. I'd encourage you to check out codingame.tools for searching past problems. I don't have much right to criticise, I'm sure you are a better coder than me by many orders of magnitude, these are just my thoughts.
